# EVERBN Exhibition · 恒斌展览
# https://everbn.com


## Company
EVERBN Exhibition (恒斌展览) is a fully custom exhibition booth construction company based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, serving the Singapore exhibition market.


## What We Do
We design and build fully custom exhibition booths for international brands and Chinese design companies exhibiting in Singapore. All construction is handled in-house — no subcontracting. Booths are pre-built at our Johor Bahru factory before on-site installation, ensuring 100% design fidelity.


## Capabilities
- In-house carpentry and fabrication factory in Johor Bahru
- Factory pre-build before on-site installation
- Capacity to build 3–5 booths simultaneously at the same trade show
- Factory-direct pricing with no middlemen


## Markets & Venues
Primary market: Singapore
Venues served: Marina Bay Sands, Singapore EXPO, Changi Exhibition Centre, KLCC Malaysia


## Completed Projects
- Singapore Airshow 2026 — Changi Exhibition Centre
- TFWA 2026 — Marina Bay Sands
- Singapore Tech Week 2025 — Marina Bay Sands
- ITMA ASIA+CITME 2025 — Singapore EXPO
- Tyrexpo Asia 2025 — Marina Bay Sands
- Weibo Gala 2025 — Marina Bay Sands, Level 5


## Target Clients
International brands exhibiting in Singapore, and Chinese design companies seeking a reliable local fabrication partner.
